title: The Police Act 1997 (Criminal Records and Registration) (Isle of Man) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the prescribed fees in the Police Act 1997 (Criminal Records and Registration) (Isle of Man) Regulations 2011 (S.I. 2011/2296).

title: The Police Act 1997 (Criminal Records and Registration) (Guernsey) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the prescribed fees in the Police Act 1997 (Criminal Records and Registration) (Guernsey) Regulations 2009 (S.I. 2009/3297).

title: The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (Emissions and Verification) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision in connection with the introduction of a new tax called the carbon border adjustment mechanism (“CBAM”). CBAM was introduced by the Finance Act 2026.

title: The Access to the Countryside (Coastal Margin) (Isle of Wight) (No. 3) Order 2026
summary: This Order appoints the day on which the access preparation ends in relation to land which is coastal margin as a result of the approval by the Secretary of State of proposals contained in reports relating to coastal access along the long-distance route on the Isle of Wight. Copies of the notices of approval are available at www.gov.uk and may also be obtained by writing to the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs, Seacole Building, 2 Marsham Street, London SW1 4DF.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Middlesborough) (No. 4) Regulations 2026
The Energy Prices Act 2022 (Extension of Time Limit) (No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary:
Section 13 of the 
Energy Prices Act 2022 (c. 44) (“the Act”) confers powers on the Secretary of State to provide support for meeting energy costs.

title: The Finance Act 2009, Sections 101 and 102 (Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism) (Interest) (Appointed Day) Order 2026
summary: This Order appoints 1st January 2027 as the day on which sections 101 and 102 of the Finance Act 2009 come into force for the purposes of the carbon border adjustment mechanism.

title: The Warm Home Discount (Reconciliation) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Warm Home Discount (Reconciliation) Regulations 2022 (“the Reconciliation Regulations”).

title: The Care Quality Commission (Additional Functions) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Care Quality Commission (Additional Functions) Regulations 2011 (the 2011 Regulations). Regulation 2 omits regulation 4A of the 2011 Regulations, removing the Care Quality Commission’s function of providing training, guidance and support to certain bodies and individuals which was inserted by The Care Quality Commission (Additional Functions) Regulations 2023 S.I. 2023/1163.

title: The Toys (Safety) (Permitted Uses for Cobalt) (England and Wales and Scotland) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Toys (Safety) Regulations 2011 (“the Toys Regulations”), to permit the presence of cobalt in toys and toy components for uses as set out in the Schedule to these Regulations.

title: The Value Added Tax (Supplies of Domestic Electricity) Order 2026
summary: This Order introduces a temporary zero rate of VAT on supplies of domestic electricity in England and Wales and Scotland. The zero rate applies to supplies made in the period beginning with 1st October 2026 and ending with 31st March 2027 by modifying Schedule 8 (zero-rating) to the Value Added Tax Act 1994 (“VATA”) so it has effect as if it contained a new Group 24 which specifies the descriptions of supplies to which the zero rate applies (see article 3).

title: The Iran (Sanctions) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Iran (Sanctions) (Nuclear) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019 (S.I. 2019/461) (“the 2019 Regulations”) and the Iran (Sanctions) Regulations 2023 (S.I. 2023/1314) (“the 2023 Regulations”) using powers under the Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2018 (c. 13).

title: The A483 Trunk Road (Welshpool, Powys) (Derestriction) Order 2026 / Gorchymyn Cefnffordd yr A483 (Y Trallwng, Powys) (Dileu Cyfyngiad) 2026
The Customs (Tariff and Miscellaneous Amendments) (No. 6) Regulations 2026
summary: Regulations 2 and 3 make amendments relating to the rate of import duty applicable to goods originating from Bhutan. Regulation 2 removes Bhutan from the list of least developed countries in Part 2 of Schedule 3 to the Taxation (Cross-border Trade) Act 2018 (c. 22) (“the Act”) and adds it to the list of other eligible developing countries in Part 3 of Schedule 3 to the Act.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Sutton Scotney, Hampshire) (Emergency) Regulations 2026
The Protection of Freedoms Act 2012 (Relevant Official Records) (Amendment) Order 2026
summary: Article 2 of this Order amends the Protection of Freedoms Act 2012 (Relevant Official Records) Order 2012 (S.I. 2012/2279) (“the 2012 Order”).

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Middlesborough) (No. 3) Regulations 2026
The Travellers’ Allowances (Amendment) Order 2026
summary: This Order amends the Travellers’ Allowances Order 1994 (S.I. 1994/955), which provides for tax and duty free allowances for goods a traveller brings into the United Kingdom in personal luggage. This instrument is only effective in respect of goods brought into Great Britain from outside the United Kingdom. In Northern Ireland the Travellers’ Allowances Order 1994 has effect as it did immediately before IP completion day, with modifications made by the Travellers’ Allowances and Miscellaneous Provisions (Northern Ireland) (EU Exit) Regulations 2020 (S.I. 2020/1619).

title: The M5 Motorway (Junctions 1 to 3) (60 Miles Per Hour Speed Limit) Regulations 2022 (Revocation) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations revoke the 60 miles per hour speed limit on the M5 motorway between junctions 1 and 3 and on slip roads at junctions 1 and 2. In consequence, the national motorway speed limit will apply upon the coming into force of these Regulations.

title: The Housing Benefit (Earned Income Disregards) (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Housing Benefit (Earned Income Disregards) (Amendment) Regulations 2026 (S.I. 2026/753) (“the Earned Income Disregards Regulations”) to clarify and extend the application of the earnings disregards introduced by those regulations to claimants of housing benefit.
